description: This Java class handles device owner related events, specifically managing profile provisioning completion. It extends DeviceAdminReceiver to perform actions when a device profile is provisioned, such as setting the profile name and launching the main activity.

classes.name: DeviceOwnerReceiver
classes.description: A receiver class that handles device owner provisioning events, enabling profile setup and launching the main activity upon completion.

methods.name: onProfileProvisioningComplete
methods.description: Called when device profile provisioning completes. Sets the profile name and launches the main application activity.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Returns a ComponentName instance associated with this receiver class.
